attempts.summary: Provisioned an encrypted (LUKS2) volume on node1, backed by a loopback file, mounted at /srv/secure via ext4, and configured an OpenRC service (secure-volume) enabled in the default runlevel so it auto-unlocks (via a root-only keyfile) and mounts on every boot. Verified via a real node restart: boot_id changed (0f0b1874... -> 3db78b50...), the service auto-started, the LUKS2 mapping came up active, and pre-existing data on /srv/secure survived plus a post-reboot write succeeded.
